questions.question: Gurman drove 28 km towards the West, took a left turn and drove 22 km. She then took a right turn and drove 18 km. She again took a right turn and drove 22 km. How far is she from starting point in a straight line?
questions.solution:
According to the given information,

1) Gurman drove 28 km towards the West.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/62cc81ff498fb79324189ca3a90fd4df123f2f107fb639290b8cc11b9b998ff5.png]

questions.question:
Three Statements are given followed by Three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements :**

Some beds are chairs.

Some chairs are tables.

All tables are cupboards.

**Conclusions : **

I. Some tables are beds.

II. Some cupboards are chairs.

III. Some cupboards are beds.
questions.solution:
The least possible venn diagram can be drawn as,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aa81aded81596b9352dfcacd814e11b80022144f6fbdb0f8b6d20e3859317f2c.png] 

**Conclusions:** 

I. Some tables are beds → **Not Follows** (This is possible but not definite).

II. Some cupboards are chairs → **Follows** (Because all tables are cupboards, and some tables are chairs).

III. Some cupboards are beds → **Not Follows** (This is possible but not definite).

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusion II follows"**.

questions.question:
Ten people are sitting in two parallel rows containing 5 people each, in such a way that there is equal distance between adjacent persons.

In Row 1 – A, B, C, D and E are seated and all of them are facing the north.

In Row 2 – P, Q, R, S and T are seated and all of them are facing the south.

Thus, each person is facing another person from the other row.

Neither A nor D is sitting at any of the extreme ends of the row. A is sitting to the immediate right of D. P is facing the person who is sitting second to the right of D. Only two people are sitting between P and Q. C is sitting to the immediate right of E. B is facing the person who is sitting second to the right of R. S is sitting at one of the positions to the right of T.

Who is facing T?
questions.solution:
According to the given information,

1) Neither A nor D is sitting at any of the extreme ends of the row.

2) A is sitting to the immediate right of D.

3) P is facing the person who is sitting second to the right of D. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/db860244c5725c42715457ddd424cb7104209ac658ff2c6d033d635e96a6fcb3.png] 

4) Only two people are sitting between P and Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/85df87f35064b21f8f4de4be68a0b502a1115e1820550187353330de754f5265.png] 

5) C is sitting to the immediate right of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/71c9f571482d72f600bcf387c5197d1b132d074e1035837bb94d4a27a0e388ed.png] 

6) B is facing the person who is sitting second to the right of R.

7) S is sitting at one of the positions to the right of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8abfe788262cabd16d5b88a52ba85c00104de1c71d4e94260796953f9becccf0.png] 

Here, we can see that C is facing T.

Hence, the correct answer is **"C"**.

questions.question: What day of the week was on 28th January 2002?
questions.solution:
Given date: 28 January 2002.

 
 

 Year
 Odd Days
 
 

 100
 5 odd days
 
 

 200
 3 odd days
 
 

 300
 1 odd day
 
 

 400
 0 odd days
 
 

Now,

Till 2002 → 2000 + 2

 
 

 Leap Year
 2 Odd days
 
 

 Ordinary Year
 
 
1 Odd day

 
 
 

 

In 2000 Years the odd day is 0,

In 2 Years the odd day is 2,

And, from 1st Jan 2002 to 28 Jan 2002:

→ 27 days in January (since we are considering up to the 28th): 27 days.

Total odd days → 2 + 27 = 29 days = 29/ 7 = 4 weeks and 1 odd days.

→ 1 represents Monday.

So, 28 January 2002 is a Monday.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Monday"**.

options.text: T is the father of S.

questions.solution:
Given Symbols and their meanings:

 ÷
 #
 
 

 **Meaning**
 Brother
 Mother
 Husband
 Sister
 Daughter-in-law
 
 

Given expression: **C - M + S + K × R # T**

Decoding the expression step-by-step:

C - M means C is M's mother.

M + S means M is S's brother.

S + K means S is K's brother.

K × R means K is R's husband.

R # T means R is T's daughter-in-law.

Family Chart:

Now check all the options:

K and M are brothers. (Correct)

T is S's father. (Correct)

S is C's grandson. (Incorrect, as S is the son of C)

R is the wife of M's brother. (Correct)

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
